name: UnSub (INC / The Gentlemen affiliates, "Phantom" framework) — SOCRadar
akas: INC = GOLD IONIC (MITRE G1032); tooling: Phantom, Ghost C2
brief: SOCRadar's Threat Research Unit recovered an exposed operator C2 server holding the affiliates' own AI session records (133 OpenCode sessions, 8,257 messages routed through OpenRouter to claude-opus-4.6 and kimi-k3), the custom Phantom framework (18 skill modules, 32 MCP servers) and a ledger of 62 named victim organizations. The LLMs planned reconnaissance, selected techniques, generated commands, triaged stolen data, drafted extortion material and produced 46 INC encryptor builds for six victims plus EDR-killer tooling; operators reframed requests as "Authorized Red Team Assessment" prompts when models refused. Exploitation per operator records included CVE-2026-35616 (FortiClient EMS), CVE-2024-57727 (SimpleHelp) and CVE-2026-41940 (cPanel). *Analyst note: a human approved each step (not fully autonomous); SOCRadar says operator records are not independently verified, deployment against staged targets is unconfirmed, and the INC/Gentlemen alliance is low confidence. Vendor source; secondary reposts overstate autonomy.* SOCRadar
